files: the realm as it was walked

records.name: Rogue
records.about: The rogue relies on his speed to deal damage at medium range while avoiding attacks.

records.name: Archer
records.about: The archer has a long-range attack and can acquire very powerful weapons.

records.name: Wizard
records.about: The wizard deals damage from a long distance and blasts enemies with powerful spells.

records.name: Priest
records.about: The priest attacks at long range and can heal himself and his allies.

records.name: Warrior
records.about: The warrior wears strong armor and uses his magic helmet to inspire his allies in battle.

records.name: Knight
records.about: The knight fights at close range, wears very heavy armor, and uses his shield to stun enemies.

records.name: Paladin
records.about: The paladin can deal damage at close range, wear armor and heal himself and his allies.

records.name: Assassin
records.about: The assassin fights from medium range and uses poison to damage his enemies over time.

records.name: Necromancer
records.about: The necromancer drains life from his enemies to heal himself and his allies.

records.name: Huntress
records.about: The huntress uses arrows and traps to defeat her enemies.

records.name: Mystic
records.about: The mystic fights with a staff and uses her crystal orb to bind enemies to a distant plane.

records.name: Trickster
records.about: The trickster fights with a dagger while using her magical prism to distract enemies.

records.name: Sorcerer
records.about: The sorcerer uses his scepter to fire blasts of chain lightning at his enemies.

records.name: Ninja
records.about: The ninja relies on speed and skill, using katanas and ninja stars to deal big damage.

records.name: Samurai
records.about: The samurai fights with a katana and uses his wakizashi sidearm to expose enemy weak points.

records.name: Bard
records.about: The bard uses his lute to inspire allies and enhance their combat capabilities.

records.name: Summoner
records.about: The summoner spawns monsters to fight for her and boost her damage output.

records.name: Kensei
records.about: The kensei dashes and slashes enemies at close range to bolster his combat effectiveness.

records.name: Druid
records.about: The druid shapeshifts between forms to adapt to any battle.

records.name: Crystal of Fortune x1
records.about:
These are more than just breathtaking crystals for an equally breathtaking person!

You can keep collecting and stacking them to be able to pick up one of several and often refreshed skins from the Tinkerer. Just head over to his cave, find the right quest and choose your reward. If you would rather use your crystals as food for your pet, feel free to do so - the feed power increases while you stack the crystals.

Note: Increment of feed power is not equal and will decrease when you hit 5 stacks: x1-x5 - 400, x5-x20 - 100

You can keep collecting and stacking them to be able to pick up one of several and often refreshed skins from the Tinkerer. Just head over to his cave, find the right quest and choose your reward. If you would rather use your crystals as food for your pet, feel free to do so - the feed power increases while you stack the crystals.

Note: Increment of feed power is not equal and will decrease when you hit 5 stacks: x1-x5 - 400, x5-x20 - 100

records.name: Nightmatter Shard x1
records.about: A seldom-known material that has recently been uncovered in alarming quantities in the Realm. Due to its precious quantity and versatile nature, it is extremely valuable, and can be used to create powerful equipment for battle. Despite its infamy among the smiths of the Nexus and the crafters of the Legion, the material itself is mysterious in its origin and usage. Upon further research, it seems that this material even possesses properties that bend space and time itself, creating windows into the past that act as visions of an elder Realm.
records.benchWhy: a shard, not gear anybody wears

records.name: Legacy Ring of Pure Wishes
records.about: Many do not realize how powerful a kind wish is.

records.name: Legacy Etherite Dagger
records.about: Made of a strange metal not known to the living.

records.name: Legacy Mantle of Skuld
records.about: He does not kill his victims. He becomes them.

records.name: Legacy Ghastly Drape
records.about: Woven from the skin of a ghast, it cannot be seen...except by the user.

records.name: Legacy Spectral Ring of Horrors
records.about: Though the whispers can be heard in your head, they're not THAT loud.

records.name: Etherite Dagger
records.about: Made of a strange metal not known to the living. Its connection to the spirit plane causes a high pitched shriek as it slashes.

records.name: Ghastly Drape
records.about: Woven from the skin of a ghast, Skuld's ability to freely shift between the mortal and spiritual plane is linked to this cloak's unusual fabric.

records.name: Mantle of Skuld
records.about: With little need for conventional armor, Skuld prefers to empower her magic arts even further.

records.name: Spectral Ring of Horrors
records.about: The charm embedded into this ring grants the power to absorb and redirect souls for placement in the afterlife.

records.name: Legacy Sentient Staff
records.about: While it may be alive, it can't speak. But, it CAN kill.

records.name: Legacy Ancient Spell: Pierce
records.about: Magical blasts can be blocked by armor, but true fear will pierce their hides and strike their heart.

records.name: Legacy Robe of Twilight
records.about: On simple observation this robe has known many owners. All are dead.

records.name: Legacy Forgotten Ring
records.about: An unsettling glow looms beneath the ancient gem's surface. Soon enough its power will be unleashed again.

records.name: Corruption Tether
records.about: This transmogrified crook bolsters the ability to peer into pocket dimensions and cling to the essence within. Such a characteristic arguably makes the staff itself sentient, a harrowing trait for the tool which gave the Shattered Kingdom its name.

records.name: Ancient Eminence
records.about: A cryptic scroll from the castle archives, unlike anything else in the forsaken collection. Only with supreme occult power may one harness the equalized power of the immortal elements, a technique long attributed to mere legend.

records.name: Twilight Shroud
records.about: On simple observation, this robe appears unremarkably standard for the dressings of the court magician. But perhaps this attribute is all too emblematic of kingdom's folly.

records.name: Defiled Equilibrium
records.about: An unsettling glow looms beneath the partitioned gem's surface, ever-changing yet always in immaculate balance. Soon enough its power may be unleashed again.

records.name: Indomptable
records.about: All initiates who start the path of becoming a Dragon Tamer are given a special weapon. If an initiate completes the Path alive, this weapon is given a name by the Elders.

records.name: Helm of Draconic Dominance
records.about: The last piece of the Taming ritual requires a man to be bound to a Dragon. Wizards were able to link a man to a Dragon's spirit using magic and pain. Using its powers comes with a great cost.

records.name: Zaarvox's Heart
records.about: Made from the Heart of Zaarvox by Ulricht the first Dragon Tamer.

records.name: Amulet of Drakefyre
records.about: Given to the initiates who survive the first challenge.

records.name: Edictum Praetoris
records.about: My staff led me to a strange arena, which seemed to have a dark aura about it.

records.name: Memento Mori
records.about: I found a great spectre floating above me. He reached out and granted me his cranium.

records.name: Toga Picta
records.about: His gift was gracious, but I would not dabble in spirits. He challenged me to a duel.

records.name: Interregnum
records.about: Our fight was glorious, but in the end, I fell in battle and joined him in undeath.

records.name: Bow of Eternal Frost
records.about: You are not a unique snowflake. You're like one of five or something.

records.name: Frostbite
records.about: So hot, it's cool. The unique combo of hot and cold elements allows it to generate devastating ice attacks.

records.name: Staff of Yuletide Carols

records.name: Brilliance Bow
records.about: A revered bow hidden away for many years by those wise enough to recognize the danger of its devastating might. Its strength is unmatched throughout the universe.

records.name: Quintessential Quiver
records.about: Royal alchemy techniques have enabled this quiver to sharpen the gilded tips held within. Arrows loosed from the case are recognized as some of the sharpest objects known to man.

records.name: Luxurious Leather
records.about: An illustrious lineage of acclaimed bowmen have passed down this famed attire. It boasts such immense defensive power that its wearer is considered invincible.

records.name: Regal Ring
records.about: A legendary citrine ring said to grant unfathomable amounts of dexterity to those who possess it.

records.name: K.I.D.D. Force
records.about: A highly unstable staff engineered to expel forceful bolts of an energy component known as K.I.D.D. (Knee-deep In Dungeon Design). It's not great now, but allegedly the second version will be better.

records.name: MMace MMurderer
records.about: A heavy mace that abides only by the power of repetition.

records.name: Mister Mango
records.about: Displaying this malformed mango in public is said to awaken the rage of a long-dormant entity from beyond.

records.name: Butter Bow
records.about: Crispy, buttered, wheat or rye. In toast it lives, in toast it dies.

records.name: Caduceus of Current Craziness
records.about: The harbinger of past pandemonium, current craziness, and future fatuity. It just can't seem to stay focused.

records.name: Blade of Ages
records.about: A katana once belonging to a royal sorcerer known for great ambition, but slow delivery. His treasured blade was prophesied to produce something wonderful... eventually.

records.name: Mirror Cloak
records.about: A brilliant cloak that utilizes the complex process of light reflection to perfectly conceal its user by creating an exact replica, mimicking the wearer.

records.name: Archerang
records.about: A quiver once treasured by a highly sentimental archer who just couldn't bear to part with her arrows forever. They've become rather dull after so much recycling.

records.name: Spelling Spell
records.about: An instructional spell used as an education tool for the training of young wizards. Before they run, they must learn to talk.

records.name: Tome of Moral Support
records.about: The deepest wounds are not physical, but psychological. Only the wisest healers are savvy enough to apply the advanced treatment this tome enables, guaranteed to revitalize allies in their times of need.

records.name: Challenger Helm
records.about: It's not easy being the best. Some wish for more, a way to inflict difficulties on themselves so that they may once again experience what it's like to not be insultingly overpowered. At last, there is a way.

records.name: Shield of Pogmur
records.about: As the heavy armor worn by most knights typically conceals their faces with a stoic expression, they require other ways to convey emotions of shock or excitement.

records.name: Seal of Eternal Life
records.about: The fruit of over a decade of research, this blessed seal at long last overcomes all limitations on its usage and never allows its user to run out of strength. A slight concession had to be made by devoting one hundred percent of its magic resources back into magic.

records.name: Lightning in a Bottle
records.about: A misguided attempt by Xolotl to grant a form of his power to followers among the Secluded Thicket, with the glaring weakness that it can only be utilized in large, open areas with direct access to the clouds.

records.name: Epiphany Skull
records.about: The skull of an enlightened philosopher who understood the true potential of necromancers to be summoners. Tragically, his overwhelmingly high IQ got the best of him.

records.name: Helium Trap
records.about: A devastating trap with some major hang time. It's full of hot air and not actually that useful, which is surely a metaphor for something.

records.name: Karma Orb
records.about: What goes around comes around.

records.name: Titan's Heart
records.about: A spirit filled vessel that lies at the core of the Sandstone Titan.

records.name: Fool's Prism
records.about: All that glitters is not gold. Beware, tricksters who choose this dastardly prism must be committed to their cruel prank.

records.name: Honey Scepter Supreme
records.about: After years of the truth being rejected by the masses, this version of the fabled Honey Scepter is automatically enhanced with the full potential it had all along.
does: Converts you to a Honey Scepter Acolyte for 60 seconds

records.name: Unshuriken
records.about: A star with high potential, but curses the user with a crippling lack of decisiveness.

records.name: NSFWakizashi
records.about: A double-edged wakizashi that exposes in more ways than one.

records.name: Omni-Impotence Ring
records.about: An unfathomable lack of strength is found in this ring. Only the most unreasonable mortals would ever consider voluntarily handicapping themselves so aggressively.

records.name: Reikoku
records.about: First summer storm cloud\nInflicting a thousand cuts\nBrilliance, then ash.

records.name: Daybreak Chakram
records.about: Circle of sunlight\nEmpowers a fragile bloom\nAnd scours the world.

records.name: Hirejou Tenne
records.about: Scarf held to the breeze\nCommanding a storm's vengeance\nHoping for silence.

records.name: Heavenly Magatama
records.about: Spiraling treasure\nPrayer beads for the downpour\nCoiled in grateful hands.

records.name: Deathless Crossbow
records.about: Distinguished archers are permitted to take their prized bow with them to the afterlife. It conjures ethereal arrows when drawn, penetrating the very souls of living beings.

records.name: Quiver of Shrieking Specters
records.about: A quiver not meant for the corporeal realm. When used by a mortal, it creates a momentary rift between death and life, briefly releasing the chilling screams of the lost.

records.name: Wraith's Brigandine
records.about: An enduring garment of spectral steel worn by the shades of the shadows.

records.name: Revenant Ring
records.about: An otherworldly gemstone is set in this oddly tight ring. It does not seem designed for human fingers.

records.name: Sakura Wakizashi
records.about: A whimsical wakizashi of Eastern origin; it has a pleasant aroma of cherry blossoms.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.about: A magical chain of infinite keys capable of unlocking the secrets of the universe, though your mileage may vary. Not to be confused with a different key-related blade.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Crystal Key
records.about: A mysterious key bestowed upon the Keyper by the Crystal Entity, imbued with an aura of forbidden magic. It fits no locks, yet it can open anything.\n\nSprite Credits: Trensient

records.name: Crystal Key Proc
hidden: an effect, not a thing worn

records.name: Mimicry Trap
records.about: A crystal trap with a built-in luring mechanism. The perimeter of the trap reflects light toward the center to create an illusionary mimic.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Prismimic
records.about: The perfectly cut head of a Prismimic, dastardly agents of the Crystal Entity. Its copying abilities are unprecedented.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Henchman's Claymore
records.about: A brutally heavy sword designed to make those at the other end of its blade know their place.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Tyrant's Wand
records.about: Granted only to the highest ranking mages of Oryx's legion, this wand conjures pagan magic forbidden by most practitioners.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Predator Bow
records.about: Not one for long distance combat himself, Oryx leaves archery training in the hands of former realm heroes who defected to his side.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Bounty Hunter's Dagger
records.about: The Mad God knows the value of cloak and dagger operations, despite his personal inclination toward more overt tactics. Oryx's minions consider it a great honor to be gifted this dagger.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Oppressor's Staff
records.about: Initially built solely for Oryx's reckless use, the construction of this staff proved potent enough to mass produce for Oryx's champions.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Blade of the Assailant
records.about: Though Oryx is only known to deploy his assassin units in times of personal need, the deliberately cruel craftsmanship of their katanas is no less remarkable.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Maize Machete
records.about: Using real corn as a weapon proved to be counterintuitive, so it was substituted with candy corn. Surprisingly, this only worsened the crow problem.\n\nSprite Credits: Bonk, Aurum

records.name: Pumpkin Prism
records.about: The innards of a pumpkin were molded into this pile that vaguely resembles a prism. Used only by the laziest scarecrows who feel the need to outsource their job.\n\nSprite Credits: Bonk, Aurum

records.name: Withered Poncho
records.about: Once worn by a remarkably ineffective scarecrow who was regularly swarmed by the very thing it swore to destroy.\n\nSprite Credits: Bonk, Aurum

records.name: Burlap Hat
records.about: A humble hat with some dirt and straw stuck between the cloth. Being a scarecrow ain't much, but it's honest work.\n\nSprite Credits: Bonk, Aurum

records.name: Bone Bow
records.about: A rib strung together by a tendon, sure to send shivers down your enemy's spines.\n\nSprite Credits: Tero, Aurum

records.name: Spinal Quiver
records.about: The sternum of a long deceased adventurer. It releases a shriek when fired, making enemies shake and shudder in surprise.\n\nSprite Credits: Tero, Aurum

records.name: Torso Tunic
records.about: A rather bare bones armor affording more protection than one would expect. This bag of bones seems so unsafe.\n\nSprite Credits: Tero, Aurum

records.name: Collarbone Collar
records.about: There's a certain irony to this macabre amulet. It's not very comfortable to wear and will seldom let you snooze.\n\nSprite Credits: Tero, Aurum

records.name: Hellfire Broadsword
records.about: A merciless blade forged in the intense fires of the realm's core, designed for use by great demon lords.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Sacrilege Seal
records.about: Paladins must take an oath of righteousness to obtain their titles. Those who defect are considered deeply cursed.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Tormentor's Chainmail
records.about: A cruel armor stitched from the victims of demonic killers, a symbol of one's ruthlessness.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Horned Ring
records.about: The severed head of an imp grew horns posthumously, an eerie piece of natural decor.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum
does: On shoot with the Healing buff
Gain 4 ATT for 3 seconds, 6 second cooldown.

records.name: Stygian Torch
records.about: A blued wooden staff lit with an undying flame. Only an extraordinarily skilled sorceress can wield the fire without this attachment.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Orb of the Sabbath
records.about: A crystal ball known to be able to summon magically constructed bats, but this technique has only been mastered by Totalia's kind.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Robe of the Enchantress
records.about: Totalia's garbs are specially fitted to be flexible enough to ride brooms. The cloth is also flame retardant, a quality which proved essential after more than one incident.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Witch's Brooch
records.about: The true source of Totalia's powers. This ornament contains a small amount of liquid freely moving inside. It's cold-hot-fresh!\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Greaterhosen
records.about: A necessary component for any beer-drinking or sausage-eating in the month of October.\n\nSprite Credits: Dappertron
does: 5% chance to gain Hallucinating for 1.5 seconds

records.name: Mighty Stein
records.about: A mighty mug for a mighty drink! Be merry!\n\nSprite Credits: Dappertron

records.name: Theurgy Wand
records.about: Oryx's so-called priests use cruel wands like this to inflict suffering on their recipients. They themselves must endure this pain to begin the path to consecration.

records.name: Ceremonial Merlot
records.about: Those who wish to be hallowed among Oryx's legion are required to drink the wretched concoction within this chalice, a mix between the Mad God's poorly kept wine and his own sentient bile.

records.name: Anointed Robe
records.about: Knowing they are to serve a more aggressive purpose on the front lines, Oryx's chosen messengers utilize a plated robe, complete with a crimson cape.

records.name: Ring of Pagan Favor
records.about: When the arduous path to anointment is complete, the priest is decorated with this symbolic ring of servitude, modeled after Oryx's famed warriors.

records.name: Bergenia Bow
records.about: Decorated with the finest flora of the realm's toughest forests, this bow uses the sharp cymes of plant life as arrows against would-be vandalizers.

records.name: Lifebringing Lotus
records.about: Sprouted and plucked from an ancient, enchanted riverbank, this flower's spores weaken the roots of evil and strengthen righteous hearts.

records.name: Hollyhock Hide
records.about: A lightweight floral coat fitted with the molted shell of a colossal insect. The energy of its evolution still pulses through, reacting upon blows.

records.name: Chrysanthemum Corsage
records.about: Expertly carved from ancient trees and fitted together with their sap, this ring's flowers have absorbed magical energy over many years, storing it within its fruit.

records.name: Swashbuckler's Sickle
records.about: A clumsy yet vicious weapon favored by marauders from coast to coast. Only an experienced pirate king can perform the techniques required to unlock its full potential.

records.name: Tricorne of the High Seas
records.about: Pirate captains wear extravagant cocked hats to both inspire their men and intimidate their foes.

records.name: Naval Uniform
records.about: The buccaneers that raided the realm before Oryx's rule famously wore such attire. Its opulence does not make for the most practical choice when sailing, but it was valued as a status symbol.

records.name: First Mate's Hook
records.about: Less prominent pirates use personal hooks to signify their rank. Though it is almost entirely symbolic on its own, no true pirate is complete without one.

records.name: Kiritsukeru
records.about: A heavy iron blade set in a handle crafted from tough wood from the eastern tundras. Each slash carries immense amounts of force.

records.name: Watarimono
records.about: A blade made from iron stuck in firm dark oak. The raw power of each strike compensates for the blunt edge.

records.name: Reinforced Root Armor
records.about: A breastplate crafted from sturdy plantlife and shards of iron. The plants seem to react when hit heavily.

records.name: Traveler's Trinket
records.about: A handy compass that reminds travelers of the homes they will someday return to.

records.name: Tideturner Trident
records.about: A decorated forked weapon which can influence and control water, sending torrential downpours of calamity at aggressors.

records.name: Slurpian Sea Scroll
records.about: An enchanted parchment, written in the Slurpian dialect. Its magic commands the tides, allowing one to propel their own movement.

records.name: Oceanic Apparel
records.about: Woven together from the silk of the oceanic Deepstriders, this robe is completely resistant to the tides of the ocean. Such garments are commonplace for royal Slurp attire.

records.name: Imperial Keepsake
records.about: As a memento of their kingdom, royal slurps are given one of these sacred pearls when adventuring out into the world.

records.name: Magic Wand
records.about: The classic kit of a magician, built to both dazzle and destroy one's enemies.

records.name: Lightshow Scepter
records.about: This enchanted cane adds pizzazz to any battle! The cleverly engineered lighting effects inside become stronger for a bigger audience.

records.name: Magician's Robe
records.about: Filled with all the necessary tools of showmanship, this dapper robe is a must-have for any true magician.

records.name: Performer's Hat
records.about: A classy top hat known to have all manner of surprises in store, including rabbits, of course.

records.name: Burning Retribution Spell
records.about: A catastrophic spell of holy destruction, concocted in secrecy by the Liturgical Ones in their quest to learn a single letter of the divine language.

records.name: Quiver of the Autumn King
records.about: A sun iron quiver passed through a royal elven lineage, whose legendary skills in archery have protected the forest kingdoms for millennia.

records.name: Cloak of Nightmares
records.about: A moonwoven cloak worn by slayer cults who spill the blood of emperors in their abhorrent mission to create a new order.

records.name: Helm of the Tribune
records.about: An ashen helm of regal grandeur, whose wearers have upraised the greatest legions and inspired total domination.

records.name: Shield of Orcish Regalia
records.about: A mighty shield smithed in the burning rivers of the demonic realms to grant the right of sovereignty over the brutal Orclands.

records.name: Seal of Invocation
records.about: A jubilant seal of celebration, granted to the most righteous crusaders as they challenge the evergrowing threat of demonic legions.

records.name: Necrofish Poison
records.about: The oceanic Necrofish's highly noxious poisons, secreted from its spines to befoul entire swaths of the seas.

records.name: Depthchaser Trap
records.about: An explosive ocean trap constructed to tear open the ironhide of the abyssal deepworm.

records.name: Dimensiongate Orb
records.about: An anomalous orb utilized by the astralmancers to banish demons who rose against them into a timeless void.

records.name: Prism of Reveries
records.about: A scintillating prism of duplicity, infiltrating the deepest corners of the mind to awaken phantasmic entities that embody hatred and fear.

records.name: Scepter of the Firmament
records.about: An azure scepter of elemental dominion, wielded by the sky charioteers to command the natural order of the overlands and the orchestration of astral bodies.

records.name: Dynastic Star
records.about: A heraldic shuriken of the ancient royal family, revered for its astonishingly lethal edge after generations of use by a mighty eastern empire.

records.name: Virtuous Wakizashi
records.about: A pristine wakizashi exalted by the archangels themselves and awarded to combatants with the most pure hearts.

records.name: Spell of Galactic Creation
records.about: A sacred spell of both order and annihilation, accumulating ancient energies to fabricate a macrocosmic system and destroy it in the blink of an eye.

records.name: Quiver of Gaia
records.about: A treasured arboreal quiver wielded by heralds of the Earth Goddess. It fires arrows of sacred life energy which smite corruption and darkness.

records.name: Cloak of Emptiness
records.about: An ancient duskcloak that shifts in and out of existence, swaddling its wearer in an all-consuming nothingness.

records.name: Helm of Imperial Right
records.about: A direhelm worn by the champions of men in their steadfast conquest of realms beyond even death.

records.name: Shield of Belligerence
records.about: An indestructible shield crafted by the earthgiants, bearing a long history of destruction and strife by entire nations who wish to claim it.

records.name: Seal of Righteous Victory
records.about: A crimson seal that is granted phenomenal power through the spilled blood of martyrs who fought for the welfare of all mankind.

records.name: Grimhydra Poison
records.about: Horrific toxins taken from the fangs of the plutonian Grimhydra, diluted with lesser poisons to make it possible for mortals to handle.

records.name: Mantlecrusher Trap
records.about: An enormously dangerous trap engineered by blastsmith dwarves to annihilate the magma dragons that threaten their underkingdoms.

records.name: Realitylapse Orb
records.about: An unstable darkquartz orb used by reality-bending warlocks to tear open holes in existence and lock away enemies of the gods.

records.name: Prism of Mindscapes
records.about: A brilliant moonjade prism cut from a forsaken jewel that corrupts the consciousness and imprints psychopathic monsters in the feebleminded.

records.name: Scepter of Luminous Winds
records.about: A vermillion scepter of the heavenly sovereign, utilized in the formation of the mortal realms by cleaving the infinite aether into a tremendous starstorm.

records.name: Circle of Unity
records.about: A marvelous treasure and destructive weapon that embodies the cardinal duality of light and dark.

records.name: Paragon Wakizashi
records.about: A flawless diamond gifted as a symbol of gratitude from the shogunate and regarded among the finest blades ever constructed.

records.name: Novice's Lute
records.about: A magical lute that inspires allies.

records.name: Oakwood Lute
records.about: A sturdy lute made of finely cut oakwood.

records.name: Iron Lute
records.about: A special lute given to apprentice musicians to compose their finest ballads.

records.name: Silver Lute
records.about: A polished lute built for combat against undead menaces.

records.about:
A crate discovered in another dimension. Open it to get one of the following:

*Squaroid Staff
*Cubic Frame
*Polygonal Garbs
*Cuband
*Mini Cuboid Necromancer Skin
*Char Slot Unlocker
*Vault Chest Unlocker
*Ambrosia
*Mystery ST Shard x5
*Golden Clover

records.name: Squaroid Staff
records.about: A radiant staff with a square-shaped conduit at its edge. Only the most prestigious of cuboid monarchs are allowed to wield such a weapon.

records.name: Cubic Frame
records.about: The angular remains of a cube. It can be temporarily resurrected through the dark arts.

records.name: Polygonal Garbs
records.about: These garbs aren't fitted for humans, making them quite uncomfortable. However, the protective properties it bestows upon the wearer are invaluable.

records.name: Cuband
records.about: Fitted with a cube shaped crystal, this band is capable of mitigating harm to the wearer.

records.name: Dalvar's Battle Axe
records.about: Elite Viking warriors and guards were given these great battle axes to use in combat. The mighty Dalvar, strongest of all the Vikings, was known to cut through enemy defenses with this finely balanced weapon.

records.name: Sunken Buckler
records.about: Recovered from the wreckage of a Viking ship, this large buckler can strike unlike any other shield. It can sustain the force of its strike in the air itself, uniquely constructed to mimic the Viking tale of Thielief the Steadfast catching a relic suspended in the air during a raid of saintly territory.

records.name: Chainmail Body Armor
records.about: Painstakingly forged through an immeasurable amount of iron rings linked together, this armor allows its wearer to remain more agile and flexible than traditional armors. The speed rivals that of the legendary Viking Diggsun, whose tide-turning charge on the edge of the battlefield won a great war.

records.name: Gjallarhorn
records.about: A ceremonial horn gifted to the Vikings from their ancient gods. Blowing it is said to temporarily bestow to the owner the power of Odin, known by some northern clans as Zimmer.

records.name: Mystery Knight ST Crate
records.about:
A crate containing the frigid tools of northern seafaring raiders, known to plunder beyond their homeland of ten thousand lakes. Open it to get one of the following:

*Dalvar's Battle Axe
*Sunken Buckler
*Chainmail Body Armor
*Gjallarhorn
*Mini Nordic Knight Skin
*Char Slot Unlocker
*Vault Chest Unlocker
*Ambrosia
*Mystery ST Shard x5
*Golden Clover

records.name: Fallen One's Blade
records.about: This cryptic blade has been forged from belligerent energies of the great beyond. Wielding it twists mortal comprehension of right and wrong.

records.name: Abyssal Insignia
records.about: A mystifying sigil from an otherwordly domain. The power sealed within causes it to faintly pull at its surroundings, attempting to draw them into the void.
does: Summon a void rift for 5 seconds
Curses enemies and deals 150-200 damage within 4.5 sqrs every 0.4 seconds

records.name: Vortex Plating
records.about: The individual plates of this armor shift constantly in and out of realms under the Void's influence. The few mortals that have found, let alone are able to wear this cursed armor become entranced in protective and destructive forces.

records.name: Eye of the Void
records.about: Though lacking physical form, this trinket grants a sense of sight that allows beings from the realm of shadow to peer into the worlds bathed in light.

records.name: Archangel's Judgement
records.about: The eldest of Daeva warriors crafted this sacred weapon to smite all that dare oppose the forces of the light.

records.name: Daevite Progenitor
records.about: A glorious artifact, bestowed upon mortals from Daeva warriors. Emulating their altruistic goals, this prism can forge countless fighters from the pure lights of the heavens.

records.name: Seraphim's Guard
records.about: These garments have been meticulously crafted over the millennia to serve the Daeva, helping them ward off and fight against the ever burning forces of darkness.

records.name: Flames of Genesis
records.about: A mere flame from the legendary forgefire used by Daeva master crafters, this trinket grants awe-inspiring powers to those deemed worthy.

records.name: Mystery Paladin ST Crate
records.about:
An otherworldly crate whose contents appear formless, only manifesting when pried open. Open it to get one of the following:

*Fallen One's Blade
*Abyssal Insignia
*Vortex Plating
*Eye of the Void
*Mini Corrupted Paladin Skin
*Char Slot Unlocker
*Vault Chest Unlocker
*Ambrosia
*Mystery ST Shard x5
*Golden Clover
records.benchWhy: consumable; not worn on the bench

records.name: Mystery Trickster ST Crate
records.about:
A holy crate assembled by an elusive angelic race seen with greater frequency in recent times. Open it to get one of the following:

*Archangel's Judgement
*Daevite Progenitor
*Seraphim's Guard
*Flames of Genesis
*Mini Daeva Trickster Skin
*Char Slot Unlocker
*Vault Chest Unlocker
*Ambrosia
*Mystery ST Shard x5
*Golden Clover
records.benchWhy: consumable; not worn on the bench

records.name: Dagger of Eternal Chaos
records.about: A vile weapon ablaze with the Void's malevolent intent.

records.name: Bow of the Sky's Glory
records.about: A celestial bow that strikes as true as its wielder's heart is.

records.name: Staff of Silver Wings
records.about: A staff that can only be wielded by those embodying both justice and power.

records.name: Wand of the Summoned One
records.about: Brought forth by an intruder from the Void, this wand has a mind of its own.

records.name: Sword of the Unending Chaos
records.about: A heavy blade wielded by the monstrous warriors of the Void.

records.name: Skybound Blade
records.about: An instrument of justice, enchanted in the clouds.

records.name: Shadowbeast Hide
records.about: Crafted from the hide of an unspeakable horror.

records.name: Robe of Dark Summoning
records.about: Said to give power over the forces of the Void, at a price higher than most are willing to pay.

records.name: Armor of Heavenly Light
records.about: The shining armor worn by the winged Daeva warriors.

records.about: A burning shard hailing from the Void itself; the concentrated torment of lost souls.

records.name: Ember of the Daeva

Heals up to 5 players within 5 tiles by 80 HP every second
When health drops below 75% boost +15 DEF for 10 seconds

records.name: Savage Claws
records.about: The jaws that bite, the claws that catch!

records.name: Beastly Mane
records.about: The Lycanthrope, with beastly mane!

records.name: Ragetorn Armor
records.about: Beware the Lycanthrope, my son!

records.name: Moonstone Ring
records.about: And shun the frumious Man-Wolf-Beast!

records.name: Tormented Shriek
records.about: When the curious Summoner first laid hands upon this artifact, it emitted a haunting shriek. The terror it stirred within her was enough to predict her demise.

records.name: Ghastly Mace
records.about: Now fated to perpetuate the Banshee's curse, the Summoner wielded power over lesser spirits.
does: A Terrible Spectre, click or hold your Summon Control button to move it.
The M.E.R.V. becomes unstable after 5 seconds.
Shoots 3 paralyzing shots thrice, then explodes for 1250 damage in 4.5 squares.

records.name: Lacerated Gown
records.about: Her robe, once boldly red, was reduced to ghostly tatters.

records.name: Unresolved Grudge
records.about: She would always carry an overpowering desire of revenge upon those that set her on this cursed path. She would pursue them for eternity.

records.name: Holy Artifact
records.about: When he heard about the horrifying Banshee at Septavius' side, the Archexorcist set out on his holiest quest yet, wielding an artifact wrested from the very hands of a God.

records.name: Tome of Exorcism
records.about: It takes zealotry bordering on madness to even dare utter the scathing words within this Tome. Its very contents blurred his vision and set his head to spinning. But he would dare.

records.name: Garb of the Ordained
records.about: He would face this threat wearing his most ceremonial garments.

records.name: Pontifex Ring
records.about: The origin of the stone in this ring, and its connection to the staff that bore the Banshee's curse: a secret he would carry to his grave.

records.name: Silver Revolvers
records.about: Lord Ruthven had acquired a veritable monster from who-knows-where. Luckily, her bullets cured lycanthropy.

records.name: Consecrated Trap
records.about: She had the Archexorcist himself bless this trap. She hoped it would be enough to help catch a miscreation of this size.

records.name: Metal-plated Corset
records.about: Of course, a quirk of her... condition was the overwhelming desire to look great.

records.name: Vial of Sustenance
records.about: And still, she would not let the Vampire's curse she carried define her. Just as she would go on to rid others of their own curses. With violence, if needed.

records.name: Cloak of Eerie Trepidation
records.about: A cloak that makes one's skin crawl with the dread of its short-lived former owner.

records.name: Hailstorm
records.about: Tugging the bowstring fiber disrupts a delicate balance between the limbs of this bow, rapidly crystallizing the surrounding frost into a serrated bolt of hail.

records.name: Thundering Chorus
records.about: Baneful beats of this waist-worn instrument rile the skies, invoking the occluded power of the storm.
does: Creates 7 additional random explosions that each deal 200-250 damage within 2 sqrs.

records.name: Wind Dancer Robe
records.about: Hardly attire of any sort, but rather a sustained cone of latent energy called forth by unseen wind spirits. Stray gusts glide beneath each step, affording both impressive speed and a thrilling lighter-than-air sensation.
does: Increases the cast range of Thundering Chorus' Lightning Strike to 10 Tiles

records.name: Augur of the Tempest
records.about: A breathtaking amulet believed to portend the will of the storm. The large stone within faintly swirls, as though an entire cyclone were somehow petrified by force of the earth.
does: Grants additional recursive thunder explosions to the lightning strike of Thunderous Chorus

records.name: Earthen Ward
records.about: Strictly speaking, this is no wand at all, and rather blunt even for a channeling device. Yet its crude appearance belies a sophisticated tool of deterrence, a contrast very much in character for the spirits of the earth.

records.name: Stonemould Mace
records.about: To fabricate colossi from within the earth is a rare and enviable practice, often deemed sacred. The creations of this club-like mace are too brittle for the interest of certain parties, but the proven potential is a precious thing indeed.
does: Stone Golem, orbits the caster, this summon has 1500 Hp and 20 Def
Summons only shoot when they are hit.

records.name: Rocky Robe
records.about: The practices of the earth mages died out with their bloodline, a consequence of notoriously being rather secretive types. But the traits of this garb, hardy and unyielding, tell much of their ways.
does: Grants Armored for 5 seconds on ability use when worn with Stonemould Mace

records.name: Steadfast Glyph
records.about: When etched into stone, this mark greatly amplifies one's resilience, as though it echoes the earth's power. Hollow relics like these are an oddity, as earth shamans regarded the designed permission of flowing air as a sign of severe fault.
does: Increases Stonemould mace summon damage to 800-1200, health to 2000, and defense to 30.

records.name: Slashing Sheath
records.about: A standard, lightweight sheath fit for enabling quick draws in a forward dash.

records.name: Timber Sheath
records.about: A dependable sheath carved of petrified wood, with a finely curved slot to optimize draw force.

records.name: Vineland Sheath
records.about: A meticulously crafted sheath built of stretched vines and parallel blades of grass for a smoother blade release.

records.name: Haze Sheath
records.about: A curious sheath designed to evoke the effortless flow of clouds and fog.

records.about: A marvelous sheath of inimitably brilliant constitution. Drawing one's blade from within emits a furious sonic wave, propelling the weapon beyond its known limits.

records.name: Asura Sheath
records.about: A detestably vengeful sheath consumed in the violet flames of Asura, a hateful deity scorned since the time of the ancients.

records.name: Volcanic Sheath
records.about: Archdemon Malphas took a conspicuous liking to this outsider's sheath, smuggled in by a newly demonic soul. Perhaps its design reminded him of something?

4 tiles with an additional tile every 10 WIS above 50.

records.name: Blitz Sheath
records.about: Swift, ruthless, and a perfect encapsulation of Oryx's militia. Vicious aggression to overwhelm one's enemies has been the Mad God's tactic of choice since the day he earned his title.

records.name: Paper Machete

records.name: Snowman's Sheath

records.name: Saif of the Deep

records.name: Loch Sheath
records.about: Masters of swordsmanship recognize how much can be learned from the flow of the ocean's waves.

records.name: Barrier Reef

records.name: Alexander's Band
records.about: A keepsake held closely by Thessal, clinging to the unlikely chance of her king's continued wellbeing. Any sailor knows this slim hope is all that contains the true beast of the seas.

records.name: Amulet of Elemental Fire
records.about: ...a driving force, indeed the driving force of nature and of civilization, would drive us once again to...

records.name: Amulet of Elemental Air
records.about: We sought to ape its astonishing force, to reproduce it in our environment...

records.name: Amulet of Elemental Water
records.about: ...the principle of things that are, Water could take all forms that make up our world, and we harnessed it...

records.name: Amulet of Elemental Earth
records.about: ...our Mother and our Essence and our livelihood... we would now seek its full potential.

records.name: Elemental Equilibrium
records.about: Within this relic all elements swirl in perfect equilibrium. What would otherwise unleash cataclysmic disaster holds together in immaculate arcane homeostasis. We would surpass it.
does: Gain +5 attack and dexterity while attacking if your health is above 90% Max HP
Gain +5 defense and +15 vitality for 10 seconds when taking damage below 60% Max HP

records.name: Tsunami
records.about: And the Great Wave bore upon our dwellings, flushing us and our beasts and our tools... but one remained, and he held aloft his blade, and summoned to himself the powers that still haunted this place.

records.name: Arashi
records.about: Our elder would look upon the storms and pondered on how a thing with no substance could leave but desolation in its wake.

records.name: Ignis
records.about: What force would do but the very force behind life and movement? No other. This weapon would prove it.

records.name: Tectonus
records.about: She had read the tomes of other races, and she had the wisdom of the Earth. She saw how we must proceed.

records.name: Book of Water
records.about: Its pages are slightly damp and little of the ink remains readable after apparent water damage. It was a treatise on Water by an eminent sage, but someone has been scribbling in the margins.
records.benchWhy: consumable; not worn on the bench

records.name: Book of Air
records.about: Not many pages remain of this tome. It was a treatise on Air by a famous philosopher, but someone has been using it to seemingly keep records.
records.benchWhy: consumable; not worn on the bench

records.name: Book of Fire
records.about: Most of this book has burned away. It was a treatise on Fire by an ancient scholar, but some of the text differs.
records.benchWhy: consumable; not worn on the bench

records.name: Book of Earth
records.about: Most of its pages have been damaged or torn away. It was a treatise on Earth by a learned one, but it has been written on again at a later time.
records.benchWhy: consumable; not worn on the bench

records.name: Lightning Rod

records.name: Wedding Dress
records.about: You can barely tell that this dress was taken from a poor bride who was buried in it.

records.name: Gothic Bouffant
records.about: This gigantic wig contains a lot of electrical energy due to being 90% wire wool.

records.name: Jagged Hatchet
records.about: The edge has been made blunt and ragged from smashing into trees, doors, walls, and pesky hikers.

records.name: Burlap Cowl
records.about: This once held potatoes. Now it can barely hold back his rage.

records.name: Overalls of Endurance
records.about: The cloth does nothing to soften incoming attacks, but the blows only make the wearer angrier.

records.name: Headless Ted
records.about: The teddy's head is down the well with the others.

records.name: Chrysalis of Eternity
records.about: As the nameless monarch sat malcontent upon the throne, his ambitions and impiety became one, and with this came enlightenment. A legacy reduced to less than legend, utterly erased from the nescient minds of the land, with its only epitaph being the sorry remnant of his majesty's dearest. After all, what good are kings in a realm of gods?

records.name: Conqueror's Crown
records.about: The symbol that claims absolute subservience from its beholder.

records.name: Night Prince Engraving
records.about: Can be used as an Artifact in the Enchanter or used directly to generate "Conqueror's Crown".

records.name: Royal Blades
records.about: These intricately crafted blades were originally intended more for ornamental purposes rather than function, but still remain potent for any form of combat.

records.name: Blazing Blades
records.about: A set of knives wrapped in an ever burning flame.

records.name: Garnet Blades
records.about: Razor sharp gemstone blades that emit a faint, magic hum.

records.name: Verdant Blades
records.about: Blades wielded only by those among the strongest of mortals, their green edges gleam in sunlight.

records.name: Occult Blades
records.about: Used primarily in ritual worship, repeated exposure to dark magic has imbued this pair of daggers with sinister powers.

records.name: Bloodshed Blades
records.about: Entire wars have been waged over the bloodstone of which a pair of these blades has been crafted from. A single pair carries the cost of thousands of deaths.

records.name: Moonstone Blades
records.about: These blades are made from a material beyond the reaches of the realm, their origin shrouded in mystery, but their edge undoubtedly sharp.

records.name: Soulforged Blades
records.about: The weight of a single swing carries the vigor of a hundred past heroes, their souls bound together in the shape of blades so they may once again slay evil.

records.name: Cloudstrike Tachi
records.about: A pair of weighty swords that carry with it thunderous strikes from its namesake.

records.name: Devilbane Tachi
records.about: Blades made from the bones of infernal beings, used to fell the same creatures it was forged from.

records.name: Darksteel Tachi
records.about: Tempered blades crafted from enchanted Darksteel and set with a gleaming ruby.

records.name: Dragonbone Tachi
records.about: This dense set of blades has been crafted with the bones of beasts only spoken of through legend.

records.name: Accursed Tachi
records.about: A pair of blades of unknown origin, within their edges a dark power can be felt, threatening to corrupt the user should they not be sated in battle.

records.name: Skyslash Tachi
records.about: Keen blades that never grow dull, their slashes threaten to split the very sky itself.

records.name: Sunset Tachi
records.about: Weapons of striking beauty, their colors displaying all the shades of twilight, each slash like a brushstroke, painting its own landscape.

records.name: Godslayer Tachi
records.about: The culmination of countless generations of swordsmiths, each perfecting their craft and improving these blades gradually. The pinnacle of weapons created by mortals for use in slaying the immortal.

records.name: Gilded Flail
records.about: Commissioned by a particularly gaudy lord for his armies, this flail gleams as brightly as the armor he was once known to wear.

records.name: Champion's Flail
records.about: Often seen used in arenas across the lands, flails like these offer a perfect balance of weight and power.

records.name: Drakerider's Flail
records.about: Once wielded by a band of knights from atop their lightning drake companions, a thunderous roar can be heard with each swing.

records.name: Infernal Flail
records.about: Forged in the fires of the underworld, the mace atop this flail emits a heat reminiscent of its origins.

records.name: Mithril Flail
records.about: A masterpiece of craftsmanship with the strongest and most desirable of all metals, as deadly as it is egregiously expensive.

records.name: Celebrant Flail
records.about: Granted only to heroes who have returned from missions of world saving renown. Those who receive it are cemented in legend.

records.name: Divine Flail
records.about: Gifted from the heavens to the most righteous of mortals, these flails have been imbued with the power of angels to subjugate evil entities.

records.name: Gravelord's Flail
records.about: The primary armament of the gravelords of old, eternally tasked with making sure the dead are forever sealed away from the mortal plane.

records.name: Fractal Blades
records.about: An impossibly intricate pattern belies these blades, carved from a self-perfecting crystalline deity.

records.name: Pirate Queen's Brigandine

records.name: Emblem of the Empire

records.name: Amulet of the Great Shaman
records.about: The bearer of this ring is linked with the spirit world, and may channel the power of a deity.

records.name: Peacekeeper (Rehearsal)
records.about: A veritable artifact from the forgotten splendor of a kingdom none wish to remember. No matter the craftsmanship of its gilded design, this unwelcome sight is now only a sobering reminder of a mistake without regret.

records.name: Vanguard's Visage (Rehearsal)
records.about: A dreadfully heavy barbute, prominently featuring inward curving horns. Such a trait has been considered taboo for eons, further marking the age of this design.

records.name: Noble Mandolin (Rehearsal)
records.about: Endless melodies from this fine instrument once filled the halls of the castle. It is without any apparent wear, yet even the most upbeat tune sounds somber when it is played.

records.name: Polarity Poison (Rehearsal)
records.about: A perfectly concentrated blend of elemental forces, primed to diverge into an explosive result if the seal is ever broken. This flawless balance is believed to be the key to a still greater power.

records.name: Sentinel's Sidearm (Rehearsal)
records.about: Use of magical weapons is typically reserved for the king's mage units. For a swordsman to receive such a fine piece of craft was considered a great honor, and perhaps still is.

records.name: Primal Arcana (Rehearsal)
records.about: This deeply profaned magitech haunts those who bear it with distant, unending screams. One's conscience must be far beyond all reason to use its tremendous and varied powers without vacillation.

records.id: item:Color Orb Red Projectile#Primal Arcana Proc (Rehearsal)
records.name: Color Orb Red Projectile
records.said: Color Orb Red Projectile (Primal Arcana Proc (Rehearsal))

records.name: Valor (Rehearsal)
records.about: Exceedingly large and challenging to handle, this titanic blade embodies the stoic might of its true owner.
does: When in combat, reduces your attack by 10.

records.name: Dusky Catalyst (Rehearsal)
records.about: An untempered casting wand brought forth to tap into distant powers, but an imbalance rendered it too unreliable for most to dare use.
does: Reduces the Magic casting cost of your Ability by 5%
When in combat, reduces your wisdom by 10.

records.name: Warmonger (Rehearsal)
records.about: Rarely brandished and in pristine condition, the old monarchy deemed this exquisite recurve too dignified for all but royalty to handle. Though it remains unproven in practical combat, this bow's raw potential is unmatched, waiting to be drawn out through pure focus.
does: When in combat, reduces your dexterity by 5.

records.name: Mantle of the Monarchy (Rehearsal)
records.about: The lavish robes of the kingdom's royalty, outfitted with pauldrons on both shoulders for a more distinguished appearance. A sinister presence remains channeled through the draping fabric.

records.name: Vest of Abandoned Shadows (Rehearsal)
records.about: Formerly a nobleman's uniform, now workshopped by the court magician into a gloomy coat befitting of his accursed company.

records.name: Royal Guard's Cuirass (Rehearsal)
records.about: Armor of the bridge sentinel, adorned with honors which now serve only as a bitter reminder of what once was.

records.name: The Forgotten Crown (Rehearsal)
records.about: An eerie reminder of what lies in the depths of the Shatters.

records.name: The Twilight Gemstone (Rehearsal)
records.about: A peculiar stone, tremendously heavy for its size and seemingly not of this world. Its very presence in the realm raises a great deal more questions than answers, yet the uncanny energy it emanates provides only one haunting clue.
does: Reduces the Magic casting cost of your Ability by 15%

records.name: Bracer of the Guardian (Rehearsal)
records.about: A colossal gauntlet of masterful composition. Its sheer size is disproportionate for most warriors, only able to be worn on one's forearm as a bracer. A once glossy exterior faded from battle long ago, yet the sturdiness of its make is as resolute as it ever was.

records.name: Shaman's Staff
records.about: A staff of grisly, warped wood cradling a luminous green gemstone. It is said to be powered by souls trapped within the gem.

records.name: Ritual Skull
records.about: The skull of an alligator, used to house spirits summoned through wicked rituals.
does: Summon a Ritual Circle for 6 seconds
The Ritual Circle gives Berserk within 3 sqrs
The Ritual Circle inflicts Slowed within 3 sqrs

records.name: Ragged Robes
records.about: Robes pieced together from coarse, ragged cloth, adorned with decorative bones and cursed trinkets.

records.name: Fang Necklace
records.about: A necklace of fangs stolen from vicious swamp creatures. The predatory strength of the beasts empowers the wearer.
does: Ritual Circle now also gives Berserk

records.name: Soul Gem Amulet
records.about: An amulet housing a powerful soul. It calls out and draws wandering spirits towards the wearer.
does: Ritual Circle now also inflicts Slowed

records.name: Toxic Toad
records.about: It croaks, you croak.
does: Throws a poison on shoot every 0.4 seconds dealing 500 damage over 1 second within 2 tiles. This poison provides has a 25% damage boost and Scales off attack.

records.name: Makeshift Blowpipe
records.about: Fully functional, but barely keeping itself together, users of this blowpipe benefit greatly from its powerful sting.

records.name: Alchemist's Disheveled Garbs
records.about: This garb is worse for wear, but users have reported a significant decrease in excruciating chemical burns.

records.name: Protective Gloves
records.about: Thick leather gloves allowing the user to handle the most toxic of materials, but harsh words still hurt the same.
does: Toxic Toad has a 5% chance to release another Poison Grenade

records.about: A tome dedicated to the works of a forgotten god. It is written in a strange script that glows with a pure white light.

records.name: Scepter of Devastation

records.about: This spell's destructive power is so notorious that casting it was banned for many generations.

records.name: Amulet of Lightning
records.about: A fine silk necklace with a bolt shaped medallion, channeling energy through it briefly grants the user the speed of lightning itself.

records.name: Experimental Cannon
records.about: This firearm was created as an experiment by welding two double-barrelled cannons together. One of the barrels fell off when it was first fired, but the other three work fine.

records.name: Sentry Turret
records.about: Turretsmiths innovate new automated defence measures to help protect the Steamworks, from rapid firing cannons to multiple flails attached to a spinning post.

records.name: Tinkerers Apron
records.about: This apron has many pockets containing supplies, pencils, blueprints and plenty of reloads. Each of those pockets has its own leather pocket protector.

records.name: Targeting Monocular
records.about: Wearing this brass monocle allows a Turretsmith to see down their turret's sights, granting them greater accuracy at the expense of personal style.

records.name: Rocket Launcher
records.about: Kogbold rockets are highly explosive.  The inaccurate nature of the weapon is made up for by the sheer volume of shots they can launch at once.

records.name: Unstable Firework
records.about: The Pyrotechnicians are supposed to work on things like blasting caps and landmines, but often get distracted by the pretty colours of a violently detonating firework.

records.name: Blast Proof Robes
records.about: You are not a true Pyrotechnician until you can prove your robes can withstand several exploding experiments.

records.name: Lucky Grenade
records.about: This grenade was launched from a firework and failed to explode. It will release deadly sparks when shaken violently enough, but until then it serves as a potent good-luck charm.

records.name: Aspirant's Sword
records.about: A steel sword with an aquamarine guard, the blade has been perfectly balanced to allow the user to attack as swiftly as possible. Those who wish to become heroes will find this weapon grows with them as they continue down their chosen path.

records.name: Aspirant's Bow
records.about: A precisely tuned compound bow with aquamarine filigree, the bow fires arrows tipped with the very same gemstone. Those who wish to become heroes will find this weapon grows with them as they continue down their chosen path.

records.name: Aspirant's Wand
records.about: A traditional warmages wand with an aquamarine focus, this particular type of gemstone can draw in more energy before discharging. Those who wish to become heroes will find this weapon grows with them as they continue down their chosen path.

records.name: Aspirant's Dagger
records.about: This dagger is crafted with a sharp aquamarine spike fitted with steel edges to form a blade. Its usage requires additional precision but its sting is heavy. Those who wish to become heroes will find this weapon grows with them as they continue down their chosen path.

records.name: Aspirant's Staff
records.about: A large oak staff set with an aquamarine gemstone, the focus on top causes it to fire more precisely than traditional staves. Those who wish to become heroes will find this weapon grows with them as they continue down their chosen path.

records.name: Aspirant's Blade
records.about: The blade of this weapon is made entirely of aquamarine gemstone and sharpened to a lethal edge, the crystal is lighter than traditional metals allowing the user to draw their blade at incredible speed. Those who wish to become heroes will find this weapon grows with them as they continue down their chosen path.

records.name: Aspirant's Plate
records.about: Traditional steel plate mail with inlaid gemstones that boost the wearers endurance. With great use this armor will shape to the user's fighting style.

records.name: Aspirant's Robes
records.about: Reinforced warmages robes, the threads of which have been interwoven with a fine gemstone that boosts the wearer’s endurance. With great use this armor will shape to the user's fighting style.

records.name: Aspirant's Hide
records.about: Mastercrafted hide armor jeweled with many small gemstones that boost the wearer's endurance. With great use this armor will shape to the user's fighting style.

records.name: Ring of the Stalwart
records.about: A sigil ring with a carved gemstone signifying the wearer's dedication to the Path of the Stalwart. An aspiring hero who wears this ring will become an insurmountable warrior capable of taking the force of any foe.

records.name: Ring of the Magus
records.about: A sigil ring with a carved gemstone signifying the wearer's dedication to the Path of the Magus. An aspiring hero who wears this ring will shape magic to their will and unleash an arcane torrent upon any that oppose them.

records.name: Ring of the Sniper
records.about: A sigil ring with a carved gemstone signifying the wearer's dedication to the Path of the Sniper. An aspiring hero who wears this ring will strike true and with a force great enough to topple even the greatest of adversaries.

records.name: Ring of the Swiftblade
records.about: A sigil ring with a carved gemstone signifying the wearer's dedication to the Path of the Swiftblade. An aspiring hero who wears this ring will move faster than their enemies can perceive and strike before they even have a chance to react.

records.name: Crystal Mace
records.about: Small particles of energy visibly buzz around inside the glistening crystals of this mace.
does: Wandering steed, click or hold your Summon Control button to move it.

records.name: Void Blade
records.about: An astronomically heavy katana. It is forged from dark matter.

records.name: E.Y.E.
records.about: The gouged eye of the ferocious F.E.R.A.L. It is no longer potent enough to generate energy beams, but the beast's psychic vision still instinctively lashes back at aggressors.

records.id: item:Esben's Shaman Attire#Esben's Shaman Attire Shiny
records.name: Esben's Shaman Attire
records.about: A glacial robe worn by the witch doctors of a bygone ice tribe during their sacred burial ceremonies. The passage of time has encased the cloth in a layer of permafrost, chilling those who fracture its coat.
does: 40% chance to Slow enemies within 6 tiles for 5 seconds.

records.id: item:Pirate King's Cutlass#Pirate King's Cutlass Shiny
records.name: Pirate King's Cutlass
records.about: Used only by the pirates who would make themselves kings, this cutlass is said to be cursed as each Pirate King seems to be killed rather unexpectedly.

records.name: Sunken Ring
records.about: Coral from the depths of the ocean which has formed into a natural ring. Painful to put on and take off, but very rare and therefore desirable.

records.name: Ghost Ship's Bell
records.about: An ancient ship's bell encrusted with dried deep kelp and bearing obscure sigils of forgotten, underwater gods. Its peals can summon fish to defend the bearer, but at what cost?

records.name: Rusted Mechanism
records.about: A rusted piece of Kogbold machinery recovered from the depths of the ocean. The only question is, how did it get on a thousand-year-old shipwreck?

records.name: Cursed Harpoon
records.about: Ancient legends say that the Phantom Diver never misses when he tosses this terrible harpoon. The fact these legends cannot be traced back to before last week is not important.

records.name: Depth Charge
records.about: A surprisingly modern explosive for breaching boats below the waterline. Don't forget to run when you throw it to avoid the blast!

records.name: Phosphorescent Rags
records.about: The glowing tatters of an old diving suit. The wearer must be a spooky ghost, and not three Kogbolds standing on each other's shoulders.

records.name: Diving Weights
records.about: Thick, lead ingots used to keep a diver's feet on the floor. They are definitely not gold bars being smuggled out of a secret mine.

records.id: item:Staff of Extreme Prejudice#Staff of Extreme Prejudice Shiny
records.name: Staff of Extreme Prejudice
records.about: Once the most powerful staff in existence; a crack in its frame has rendered it incapable of focusing fire. It remains uniquely deadly.

records.id: item:Shield of Flowing Clarity#Shield of Flowing Clarity Shiny
records.name: Shield of Flowing Clarity
records.about: This shimmering shield allows knights to enhance their concentration on targets, giving them more time to think about their next move in battle.

records.id: item:Wakizashi of Eastern Winds#Wakizashi of Eastern Winds Shiny
records.name: Wakizashi of Eastern Winds
records.about: A wakizashi used by a powerful swordsman in ancient times. It seems to dance through the air as you swing it.

records.name: Primal Arcana

Hits with Vampire Blast Purify status effects within 3.25 Squares

records.name: Corruption Cutter
records.about: A fragment of Lord Ruthven's curse manifest itself into this pulsating dagger. Its formless state allows it to cut in ways no other weapon could.

records.name: Warmonger
records.about: Rarely brandished and in pristine condition, the old monarchy deemed this exquisite recurve too dignified for all but royalty to handle. Though it remains unproven in practical combat, this bow's raw potential is unmatched, waiting to be drawn out through pure focus.
does: When in combat, reduces your dexterity by 5.

records.id: item:Quiver of Shadows#Quiver of the Shadows Shiny
records.name: Quiver of Shadows
records.about: A mysterious quiver formed of corruption and dark matter. Its ethereal existence creates a small implosion of nearby atmosphere when drawn.

records.id: item:Amber Encrusted Helmet#Amber Encrusted Helmet Shiny
records.name: Amber Encrusted Helmet
records.about: Decorated with ancient amber, this helmet's idle solitude over many years have caused its abilities to dwindle.

records.name: Blade of Fates
records.about: Her blade of choice was cursed to be unfit to harm the likes of gods. Through accursed soul binding, she found a means to adapt this curse into a terrifying weapon.

records.name: Accursed Memory
records.about: The death throes of a powerful demigod remain sealed within the crystalline exterior, but are briefly unleashed as the soul desperately attempts to cling onto life, pulling onto the life force of nearby souls only to strengthen its prison further.

records.name: Gravetender's Vest
records.about: A well-worn studded leather that has witnessed many battles and many more losses. It is the common wear of those who must bear the burden of burying those forever lost to the fight against the gods.

records.name: Jewel of Vengeance
records.about: Concentrated within this gemstone are souls of vengeance, burning to serve one final role to smite the oppressors of the living.

records.name: Nebular Rod
records.about: A pristine cloud of nebular stardust gently rests atop a focusing rod in a tranquil stasis, until it is catalyzed into a microscopic genesis of stellar proportions. It is a reminder of the thin divide between uncreation and creation, a transcendental dance of the cosmos.

records.name: Cosmic Astrolabe
records.about: A glassy projection of arcanic lights provide an accurate chart of the stars beyond the Realm. Through a careful process of measurement and divination, one can travel along ley lines of starlight to reach worlds unknown.

records.name: Astronomer's Gown
records.about: What was once the simple vestments of an astronomer have become a curtain of stardust and dreams, a priceless record of countless travel through worlds that may never be visited again.

records.name: Eye of Divination
records.about: A crystalline formation in the shape of an eye remains the sole artifact of the journey’s true purpose- a secret beyond the stars waiting to be discovered. Beyond the dark horizons of the cosmic plane, what else has Cronus left behind for the explorers of the present to discover?

records.name: Spellbound Soulthief Set Token

records.benchWhy: a material, not gear anybody wears

records.benchWhy: a material, not gear anybody wears

records.name: Monochrome Staff
records.about: A legendary weapon whose attacks are said to be as intense as its red color. Rumor has it that this may not even be the original.

records.name: Treasure Orb
records.about: Another orb in an endless myriad of orbs for heroes to collect. What makes this specific shape so special?

records.name: 1-Bit Robe
records.about: No matter how you look at this garment, it is always distinctly black and red, with no in-between shades.

records.name: Strange Ring
records.about: It is hard to make out what is on top of this ring. Maybe it is an eye or some sort of gem?

records.name: Turncoat Cape
records.about: This covering is assigned to Oryx's negotiators to conceal weaponry and get away with stolen fortunes.

records.name: Diplomatic Robe
records.about: The diplomacy of Chancellor Dammah goes as far as his limited patience. The true purpose of this robe is its deeply woven enchantment to bolster arcane powers.
does: Summon a portal which deals 125 damage and zaps enemies in a radius of 5 every 0.4 seconds

records.id: item:Vesture of Duality#Vesture of Duality Shiny
records.name: Vesture of Duality
records.about: This cursed robe overwhelms the wearer with conflicting thoughts of good and evil, shattering the will of the weak-minded.
does: Boosts attack by 15 and decreases defense by 6 for 5 seconds

records.name: Centaur's Shielding
records.about: Specially weighted plates layered inside this armor channel greater force into every motion of the body for destructive blows.
does: Increases attack by 12 for 4.5 seconds if the user has the Healing status effect

records.name: Gladiator Guard
records.about: Although refurbished, this breastplate is the very same Oryx received as a gift from the royal family in celebration of his gladiatorial prowess.

records.name: Spider Shuriken
records.about: An arachnid star which slings silk to tangle predators while granting oneself the speed and stamina of Arachna's most agile young.

records.name: Faithful Spatha
records.about: A tried and tested weapon used extensively by Commander-Lord Carosburg's soldiers.  It has a good weight for chopping, and a fine edge which can slice through most armour.
does: Creates additional projectiles when worn with an Amulet.

records.name: Temporal Wand
records.about: Cronus made many prototypes for different wands, with this being one of his most popular amongst his students, as the shots can injure a target in the past as well as the present.
does: Creates additional projectiles when worn with an Amulet.

records.name: Reliable Pugio
records.about: A swift and deadly dagger used as a backup weapon by soldiers in Commander-Lord Carosburg's armies.  It is also very useful by itself, and has ended many lives on the battlefield.
does: Creates additional projectiles when worn with an Amulet.

records.name: Transdimensional Bow
records.about: While it appears to the untrained eye that this bow only fires three arrows, it actually fires hundreds across all dimensions, as Cronus designed it to hit every possible variation of the target.
does: Creates additional projectiles when worn with an Amulet.

records.name: Deathmask Staff
records.about: Out of respect for their missing teacher, students of Cronus will mount a stone mask of his face to a staff to use as a focus.  They will often wear these masks or use them as ornaments as well.
does: Creates additional projectiles when worn with an Amulet.

records.name: Legions Odachi
records.about: A frighteningly sharp blade from the eastern lands, modified for use in Commander-Lord Carosburg's forces by executioners and elite duellists.
does: Creates additional projectiles when worn with an Amulet.

records.name: Temperate Curiass
records.about: Balanced between might and mysticism, the leather and metal of this light armour provides good protection and mobility.
does: Creates an on-hit effect when worn with an Amulet.

records.name: Glorious Banded Plate
records.about: Polished to a high sheen, these banded plates proudly announce the prowess of the wearer in battle. Only the best of Commander-Lord Carosburg's foot troops are qualified to wear them.
does: Creates an on-hit effect when worn with an Amulet.

records.name: Insightful Mourning Robe
records.about: Robes which signify the wearer follows the wisdom of the missing magus – Chronus. The small death masks worn as charms are said to symbolise his teachings.
does: Creates an on-hit effect when worn with an Amulet.

records.about: A slow but powerful sword that is a relic of a long forgotten age.

records.name: Vanguard's Visage

records.id: item:Ring of Decades#Ring of Decades Shiny

records.name: Ray Katana
records.about: A great katana charged with the power of the sun itself.

records.name: Ship's Wheel Shield
records.about: How can something with so many holes in it be useful in defence? By spinning it so quickly nobody can strike you through the holes, of course!

records.name: X-Marks-the-Spot Spell
records.about: This ancient, cursed treasure map causes treasure to appear in front of the caster.  As the coins and jewels overlap in physical space this causes a massive explosion.

records.name: Tome of Piracy

records.name: Brine Quiver
records.about: Arrows placed in this quiver become encrusted with a layer of sea salt, and turn into augurs of seawater when fired.

records.name: Crossbones Skull

records.about: An incredibly complex and durable crystalline structure appears on this pendant where a druid might expect the representation of an animal. Familiarising oneself with its forms is incredibly difficult but druids who succeed find themselves to be unbreakable walls against all forms of threat.

records.name: Celestial Recurve
records.about: A wondrous bow of heavenly origin, harnessing Daevic magic to bend and concentrate light into tangible projectiles. At the point where these beams intersect, a dazzling burst of celestial brilliance radiates.

records.id: item:Mace of the Pumpkin Effigy#Mace of the Pumpkin Effigy Shiny
records.name: Mace of the Pumpkin Effigy
records.alias: Mace of the Pumpkin Effigy Shiny
records.about: A sinister twist on the scarecrow's intended use. Totalia bewitched these cursed figures with an uncanny allure to enthral victims into their untimely demise.
records.clientId: Mace of the Pumpkin Effigy Shiny

records.name: Pirate's Artillery
records.about: Although cannons were once typically associated with naval warfare, many pirates now regard Bilgewater's application of them in land-based combat as revolutionary.

records.id: item:Skull of Restless Souls#Skull of Restless Souls Shiny
records.name: Skull of Restless Souls
records.about: An unnaturally pristine skull adorned with a crown of thorns. Various parts of this once holy figure continue to be worshipped as sacred relics post-mortem as they bestow graces and miracles through the traces of divine power abiding within.

records.name: Doom's Emblem
records.about: An accursed sigil that beckons to one's inner demons. Unholy paladins can unleash their dormant latent potential by forming a pact with an otherworldly force through a tribute of their own flesh and blood.

records.name: Cavalry Lance
records.about: A resplendent, gilded lance once wielded by a legendary horseback rider of yore during the great Draconic Cataclysm. Its formidable reach could slay monstrous dragons with seemingly impenetrable bodies by impaling their deeply buried hearts.

records.id: item:Cloak of the Deep#Cloak of the Deep Shiny
records.name: Cloak of the Deep
records.about: An enchanting cloak that conceals its wearer in a veil of iridescent bubbles. The shimmering cascade of bubbles serves as the only lifeline within the sea's deepest hadal trenches.

records.name: Evolutionary Records
records.about: An ancient volume recording ancestral lineages dating as far back as the Primal Era. Infused with the essence of druidic magic, it grants the power to delve into nature's eternal transformation, morphing its caster into formidable creatures.

records.name: Pollen Incendiary
records.about: A diabolical fusion of magic and chemical warfare engineered by Dr. Terrible in his effort to subjugate the Nest. When unleashed, it triggers a cataclysmic chain reaction between the charged volatile pollen that engulfs the air in a blinding and roaring inferno.

records.name: Bloodbath Blade
records.about: A malevolent katana infested with parasitic organisms. The ravenous symbiotes instills in its user a thirst for blood, which grows as it drinks from the life force of its wielder and their foes alike.

records.id: item:Runes of Knowledge#Runes of Knowledge Shiny
records.name: Runes of Knowledge
records.about: A stone slab adorned with enigmatic symbols, harkening to an era of ancient technology still shrouded in obscurity. These same inscrutable runes are found etched on surfaces within the Tundra, beckoning those who dare to decipher their secrets.
